title: ARC owner authorization token
description: claims/<TASK-ID>/authorized.json - the owner's execution grant. Written ONLY by /arc-authorize. Its presence is the authorization; claim.state AUTHORIZED without a valid file here fails closed to BLOCKED and is never repaired by a worker.

taskId.description: Must equal the containing directory name and the claim's taskId.

planId.description: Plan identity is carried so an authorization cannot silently survive a plan change (contract section 6.3).

authorizedBy.description: Owner identity. Provenance for review, NOT an unforgeable credential - see the R-1 note below.

note.description: Optional owner text recording the scope or condition of the grant.

ownerToken.description: RESERVED, UNUSED IN V1. Contract R-1 records that nothing in the filesystem prevents a worker writing this file; allowed-tools is not runtime-enforced (execution-plan conflict X-9). The available mitigation is an owner-supplied value a worker cannot derive. It is deliberately not built in V1, and this field exists so adding it later requires no schema change.
